description_text:
- +/- 1,357 Square Foot 2 story Home . House has Brown Siding Exterior Walls. Brown Window Frames and White windows, White Doors. Property has a white fence. House has a front porch with roof and a roof over stairs in the back yard as well. House also incldues air vents on roof.

  - High Detail Exterior Model. Interior is NOT modeled. House also includes entire site, including yard, sidewalks, fence,curb and curb cut, grass. 

  - This house will be part of a series that will make up an entire city block. 

  - House Modeled to Scale and Dimensions: US Imperial

  - House Model is: 36' feet x 25 feet x 24 feet 9 inches high at high point of roof. Polygons: 11,835 Vertices: 11,975

  - Site: 151 feet x 43 feet wide. Dimensioned from back of yard to front of curb and street. Polygons: 20,024 Vertices: 12,102

  - First Floor: +/- 887 Square Feet

  - Second Floor: +/- 469 Square Feet.

  - Materials: Shingles, Concrete, Siding,Metal Panel,grass, road, wood. Trim, Door, can all easily be changed to any color.

  - -Exterior Only, no interior modeled. no interior walls

  - -Grass has a subdivision and displacement modifier in 3ds max for 3D effect, it can be turned off

  - -Modeled in 3ds Max 2015, rendered using Vray and HDRI lighting, HDRI NOT included

  - -Set to 0,0,0 Axis 

  - -All House objects grouped into a single group for easy scene movement.

  - -All Site objects grouped into a single group for easy scene movement.

  - -Glass is reflective so you dont see inside as much, can be changed based on scene

  - -Gutters Included

  - -Mailbox Included

  - -Air Conditioning Included

  - -Great house for any infill scene

  - -Address can be changed in 3ds max, its a max text.

  - -All textures included in Zip file, Textures will have to be relinked from folder. 

  - -Please note model was made in 3ds Max and other provided formats have not been tested in other software and may need modifications, buyer is responsible for corrections into other software, reach out for assistance as required.

  - -FBX file has Y rotated Up for import into Unity and at 0 vertical

  - Thanks

- this model is based on real data therefore this is a realistic buildings and streets setup of Nanjing, China

  - 5 building groups are setup so that you can add variety to buildings (color materials and/or textures) Groups can be turned off/on

description_text:
This is a set of concrete blocks. Two types, one with arc shape and one with cone shape. From both types there two separate versions so it is easyer to scatter them accros bigger area. 
This asset was created with photogrametry techniques and it represents realistic 3d mesh and realistic diffuse texture. Photos for photogrametry was taked during overcast day which ensures minimum shadows from local day light. 3D mesh is open and hollow from the bottom part, this is good to keep in mind.
Package contains Hi poly and Low poly objects, dependet on type of usage. This asset is prepared with Vray and Corona shaders for 3Dsmax. This shader is basic with applied diffuse map. There is no reflection, bump or displacement maps included. Package also includes 4k and 8k maps for different type of usage.

If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

description_text:
This is my recreation of Viktor Schauberger's famous invention known as the whorl pipe. The whorl pipe is a water vortex flow pipe that changes the flow characteristics of water using it's unique biomimicry derived geometry.  Its design has been refined through four previous iterations and extensive research into Viktor and Walter's work. This particular tube is designed to be as close to the original as possible. The only surving photo of Viktor's orignial pipe is included above (the black and white image).
This design includes unique characteristics  of the orignal such as the cycloid spiral space curve geometry taken from Kepler's harmonic spiral as well as the hyperbolic funnel, bothof which are fundamental concepts in Schauberger's writings. The design is based on careful analysis of the only surviving photo of the whorl pipe actually used in the successful Stuttgart experiments. It also stays true to the original design principles of Viktor's. I can say with some certainty that this is the closest replication to the original whorl pipe made by Viktor that has EVER been published in a public setting!
This is the most up to date and advanced whorl pipe 3D printing file available today. Based on the Popel experiments, it is believed that water should be spun in a vortex in an egg shaped basin with a rubber hose at the bottom which attaches to the inlet of this pipe for the best results. Experiments to this end are ongiong. *This file is available here for research purposes only. *

description_text:
This is a very large theoretical reconstruction of the area of the temple of Baalshamin in Palmyra, it is based on the year 300 and contains assets which can be easily placed in adventure games or explored with a character as a whole ready scene for adventure games, scientific studies or documentaries. All the procedings from the sales of this model will be used to fund my ongoing PhD in which I intend to reconstruct the entirety of the town of Palmyra and make an interactive educational game where the user will be able to explore and interact with the town in an advanture game style exploration mode. At the moment I am focussing on the area of Baalshamin, but with more public funds I will be able to reocnstruct more and more areas till the entire town will be rebuilt. 
Temple of Baalshamin
Temple of Baalshamin 3D model
Description
The 3D model was created on actual archaeological information and historical investigation. Model formats:
*.Blend (Blender)*.StlAll texture is included in the set.renders Are made in Blender If you need any other formats I am more than happy to make them for you. The model is provided combined, all main parts are presented as separate parts therefore materials of objects are easy to be modified or removed and standard parts are easy to be replaced. If you experience difficulties with separating standard parts I am more than happy to give you qualified assistance. I greatly appreciate you choosing my 3D models and hope they will be of use. I look forward to continuously dealing with you. Enjoy it!Sincerely Yours,
Luca

Calla Lily ( Zantedeschia sp. )  
Height : 60 cm to 113 cm included
Origin : Africa
Environment : near waters; in full sun or partial shade; on rich, humid soil
Climate : warm, mild  
Notes :
The Calla Lily is an African species that grows in the South of the continent. It was scientifically named after the Italian botanist Giovanni Zantedeschi. The common name Calla comes from Ancient Greek kalòs (beautiful), and looking at the flowers it is easy to understand why that name. The leaves of Calla Lily are basal (they grow directly from the underground bulb), and are part of the charm of the plant. In the language of flowers, the Calla Lily stands for Beauty and Instability. Due to the slender, neat and curvy shape, Calla Lily had a big aesthetic success in the early 20th century, when it became the symbolic flower of the Liberty Style.

description_text:
•         Let me present to you high-quality middle-poly 3D model of table Industriart Greyglass. It is a 3D copy of the real table of Russian manufacturer Industriart that makes industrial design furniture.  This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.... 
•        The well topology of middle-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
•        The model uses 2 materials - 1 for metal and 1 for tabletop glass. Material of metal uses 2 textures (Diffuse and Bump). Bump depth multiplier for metal material need set is 0.1 – 0.2.  Material of tabletop uses 3 textures (Diffuse, Specular and Glossiness).
•        The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. Dimensions of real table is W114xD80xH76cm (W45”xD31,5”xH30” inches). All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Middle-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
See also our other models of this manufacturer.

description_text:
Boston House 04 - Enterable
High quality Wooden House created references to a real life building located in boston, with much detail to it, such as dirty wooden Brown wooden planks and pillars, roof and a detailed entrance with a door and windows.
In this pack i included both the Enterable, and Non-Enterable House,The Enterable version, has three very detailed rooms rooms with Windows,and is perfect for games like Open world / Survival, as an abandoned House,to find loot etc.
The Non-enterable is perfect for decoration on the vast landscape, or in city environments,and much less triangles and vertices for better Performance.
Enterable House - Low Poly Triangles - 7754 Triangles - 6929 Vertices
Non-Enterable House - Low Poly Triangles - 3518 Triangles - 2836 Vertices
4096x4096 TGA/PNG/JPG Textures - Specular & Normal
Textures is created using Photoshop, and has a Diffuse, Normal & Specular to its base.
Work around with its material, and you can easy find the right settings for it.
PS. The Exterior version can also be purchased individually at my store.
File Formats :.Max2016.Max2015.Max2014.Max2013.FBX.OBJ.3DS.DAE

description_text:

Scale and rotations are applied to avoid issues during editing.In the scene file the cameras are bind to frames. Simply hit Animate to render the object sequentially from all the camera angles.

This enormous concrete complex, with commercial function in the lower and residential in the upper floors, is located in Belgrade's busy boulevard and contributes to the highly urban sense of the neighborhood. It is more than 200m long, 70m high, built in the communist era. As such, it doesn't reall tend to fit the neighborhood but rather to create new focal point and reference to the city. Great for creating raw, concrete cityscapes. It is very low geometry, vegetation is of 2 planes, and photo-textured.
Modeled with SketchUp and exported to other formats.

description_text:
EAMES MOLDED DINING CHAIR - DCW
Design Charles & Ray Eames®, 1946
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Modeled from blueprints and highly accurate.
The model comes with a high-resolution, high-quality wood diffuse, bump, specular maps, allowing for a variety of looks. Two V-Ray wood materials are prepared - dark (oak) and light (bleached ash) veneer. The wood body has two separate sets of UV coordinates, allowing you to change the main material while retaining the plywood border texture on edges. It is possible to use a multi-material plywood: veneer matID 1, edges matID 2.

The Max model (3ds Max 2010) is already optimised and shaded for use with V-Ray (2.0). It includes two different looks for the chair. All elements are named for easy handling and accurately scaled in millimeters. Just merge the model of your choice into your scene, check the map paths, and render!

All other formats includes a fully smoothed hi-poly version of the chair and a low-poly version, which can be smoothed as needed for more details. Non-Max versions do not include material definitions, however the model is carefully UV-mapped, making it easy to re-create the original materials from the provided texture maps.

description_text:
This is a city-block worth of buildings which can be used however your imagination desires: it could be a derelict town or a tropical city or town or even a run-down city.
This set includes all three models:Set A: High rise and lower buildings in a square street layout.Set B: A set of buildings in a north-south street layout.Set C: Densely packed buildings in a square street layout.
The city block includes buildings which are viewable from all 4 sides. This means you can rotate the model for a different look.All of the Shanty Town 2: City Block A, B, and C models are built at the same scale, which means you can combine, duplicate, and reposition the models to create an even larger city.
This model also works great with the Shanty Town 1 models.
Product Features:

  - Set A: Vue vob file, with 4,595 polygons.

  - Set B: Vue vob file, with 2,669 polygons.

  - Set C: Vue vob file, with 4,826 polygons.

  - The buildings and fences are separate body parts which can be hidden or shown to suit the needs of your scene.

  - If you look close, you may be able spot opening doors.

  - Duplicate and rotate the city block to create an even larger city.

Textures:

  - One set of texture maps, ranging from 2048x2048 to 4096x4096 pixels, and some with corresponding normal/ bump maps.

  - Large texture maps make it perfect for both close-up and medium-range shots.

All textures are incorporated into the Vue vob file and no textures are included in the zip file.
For use in Vue d`Esprit 2016 and above and it can not be imported into any other software.

description_text:
Detailed model made based on one of the drawings of Sant'Elia.
The model represents one of the draws made by Antonio Sant'Elia in 1914 for the Cittá Nuova New city. In this case it is a terraced building with external elevators and it was part of the exhibition of the Nuove Tendeze group, of wich he was a member. Sant'Elia died at 1916 when he was only twenty eight years old, however his drawings influenced many architects and designers along the time.
All objects have his axis at the same place and situated at the origin point of Z.
Max version include two files, one with scanline render setup and standard materials and other with mental ray lights and materials. Also a camera with settings and correction modifier is included in order to render a similar view of original drawing.
No cameras and light setup in 3DS, OBJ and FBX files.
PDF file with instructions is included.

description_text:
Scale model of a German locomotive from World War II, complete with realistic piping, valve gear and crew cabin controls! Known as DRB Class 52 Kriegslokomotiv or simply BR-52.
This model was built using blueprints and many personal photos! Max model is appropriately divided into multiple objects (and several groups containing these objects).
There are over 100 different objects, all named and separated (eg: Frame, Boiler, Cabin, Brake Piping, Tender Truck, etc.) I forgot to adjust the pivots on some of these objects, but centering the pivot point will fix this for most cab valves and levers. Most of the valves and levers in the cabin are separate objects, and all of them are correctly labelled. Valve gear (wheel driving mechanism) is also separate and can be animated.
Scene contains a dozen materials or so. Note that the locomotive is NOT texture mapped! The tracks are mapped, and the textures are provided and can be linked with the railway tracks. The locomotive is made out of materials only!
This model contains many n-gons in an effort to lower the final poly-count. It is NOT a model you would want to subdivide! The geometry is clean - no polygons inside model, no flipped normals, no overlapping vertices, no missing polygons! Clean render from ANY angle!
Final Notes: The two optional track textures are in the rar file. I also included two background images that I used in the color renders! Lights are set up, and you must only link the background photo before rendering in Mental Ray.
3DS model does not contain textures/materials. SKP model contains materials. 3D model is also great if you're using it as reference for a real model - note: is not designed to 3D print.

description_text:
Historical American 4-4-0 steam locomotive from 1865, complete with accurate components, valve gear, pipes and cab controls. Built and UV Mapped in 3DS Max 2013, rendered in Mental Ray.
This isn't a model of any specific locomotive, but it accurately reflects American steam locomotive construction from the period. Model includes accurate frames, injector pipes and driving gear mechanism, with each component separated and named. This is one of the few models available that includes accurate cab controls (for the engineer and fireman).
Scale model has been UV Mapped and the textures - diffuse, specular and bump - have all been included in jpeg format in the RAR file. The textures give the locomotive a weathered, industrial look - somewhat rusty on top and dirty underneath. This was done on purpose to make the old engine look more realistic.
How To Add The Textures Open the .max model in 3DS Max. Select the locomotive. Go the Slate Material Editor... add the diffuse, specular and bump maps. Do the same for the Tender. A few less important objects (like the chains and tracks) have a simple material applied to them - these are not texture mapped. The loco and tender have their own separate texture files.
Note: Make sure you have a fast enough machine that can handle 4048x4048 textures, or you may have to reduce the texture size. A set of secondary textures located in the texture folder have been converted to a lower bitmap quality and take up less space. This model does not support sub-division.

description_text:
Steampunk time bomb
A time bomb (or a time bomb, time-bomb) is a bomb whose detonation is triggered by a timer. The use (or attempted use) of time bombs has been for various purposes including insurance fraud, terrorism, assassination, sabotage and warfare. They are a popular feature in fictional thriller and action films as they offer a way of imparting a dramatic sense of urgency.
Steampunk is a retrofuturistic subgenre of science fiction that incorporates technology and aesthetic designs inspired by 19th-century industrial steam-powered machinery. Although its literary origins are sometimes associated with the cyberpunk genre, steampunk works are often set in an alternative history of the Victorian era or the American Wild West, where steam power remains in mainstream use, or in a fantasy world that similarly employs steam power.

description_text:
The Variable Specific Impulse Magnetoplasma Rocket (VASIMR) is an electromagnetic thruster for spacecraft propulsion. It uses radio waves to ionize and heat a propellant. Then a magnetic field accelerates the resulting plasma to generate thrust (plasma propulsion engine). It is one of several types of spacecraft electric propulsion systems.
The VASIMR method for heating plasma was originally developed from nuclear fusion research. VASIMR is intended to bridge the gap between high-thrust, low-specific impulse and low-thrust, high-specific impulse systems. VASIMR is capable of functioning in either mode. Former NASA astronaut Franklin Chang Díaz created the VASIMR concept and has been developing it since 1977.[1]
VASIMRs units for development and test are assembled by Ad Astra Rocket Company.

description_text:
ABOUT MODEL:-

  - This is a Realistic 3d model with Texture.

  - Ready to drop into any scene or be used as a stand-alone prop.

  - Real world scale and exact proportions.

  - Excellent polygon efficiency.

  - The model has a different topology and realistic textures. The model is perfect for you for a variety of purposes.

  - Model is suitable for use in games.

  - Model have only basic wall (no interior wall)

MATERIAL & TEXTURE:-

  - All materials in Multi Sub-Object.

  - Material and Texture setup is included only in MAX FORMAT (vray and scanline version).

  - UVW Mapping are applied.

  - All textures are in defuse map.

  - Textures can be easily repaint.

LIGHTING:-
  - Studio setup is not included.
FILE FORMAT:-

  - 3DS

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - Blender 2.79

  - Cinema4d R11

  - Maya 2010

  - MAX (Vray Version)

  - MAX (Standard Version)

  - Native file is 3ds Max 2009(max)

  - Other formats were converted from the MAX file.

OBJECTS:-

  - Same material objects are attached for easy selection.

  - All objects are unique named.

WARNING:-Depending on which software package you are using.The exchange formats(obj, 3ds and fbx) may not match the priview images exactly.Due to the nature of these formats, there may be some textures that have to beloaded by hand and possively triangulated geomatry.
Thank you for your interest in this model.

description_text:
This pack features 5 custom designed high detailed brandless cars with real cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car models.
*LowPoly
*Detailed exteriors
*Detailed interiors
*Detailed engines
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the standard files.
*The cars are linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The renders are made in a real time environment using realtime shaders and pre-baked AO maps. (baked in blender)

description_text:
This realistic highly detailed model of an engine stand is part of a series of garage tool models and uses pbr textures.

  - This model has been created using blender 2.79 with the bevel edge and subdivision modifiers to control sharp edges and to improve smoothness of the model. To add more geometry simply increase the subdivision modifier level to a higher setting in the blender file

  - The model has been supplied in FBX and OBJ formats as base mesh (modifiers NOT applied) and subdivision applied at level1 as seen in the renders.

  - The vertices count for the model are 53928 vertices,127984 tris and 63252 faces for the base mesh and 667316 vertices, 1334760 tris and 667364 faces for the subdivision level 1 files.

  - Textures have been provided for each individual object within the model, maps include (Base, height, metallic, roughness, normal). These have been supplied at a minimum of 1024px by 1024px jpeg formats, although some have been created at 2048px by 2048px to maintain scratch and grunge detail. these textures have also been provided in both basic and grunge texture packs. 

  - Empty control points have been added to the blender to aid animation as used in the demonstration video. This model, however, is NOT a fully rigged model.

  - Athough not specifically designed for game development, these files have been open successfully in Unity.

description_text:
Original creation of Atomic Joe
Project Date: 5/29/2019Time: ~30-60 hrsSoftware: Blender 3D
SpaceX Merlin 1C semi-complete engine model in the non-vacuum configuration.
Included file formats: .obj .stl .fbx .dae
Three versions of the Merlin 1C engine were produced. The Merlin engine for Falcon 1 had a movable turbopump exhaust assembly which was used to provide roll control by vectoring the exhaust. The Merlin 1C engine for the Falcon 9 first stage is nearly identical to the variant used for the Falcon 1, although the turbopump exhaust assembly is not movable. Finally, a Merlin 1C vacuum variant is used on the Falcon 9 second stage. This engine differs from the Falcon 9 first stage variant in that it uses a larger exhaust nozzle optimized for vacuum operation and can be throttled between 60 and 100 percent.

description_text: Files for a GP11 EMD locomotive in HO (1:87) and N (1:160) scales. Included are printable STL files as well as Sketchup files for the locomotive in HO and N. The Sketchup files are water tight, print ready, and can be edited and rescaled. Note that the scaling in the Sketchup files is ten times larger than the scale size due to Sketchup performing poorly at tiny scales. The HO model is designed for Plano GP7/9 Intake Screen #14860, GP7/9 Intake Shutters Set #14861, Cannon and Co 1707 36 In Cap Top Radiator Fan, and EMD stanchions. Will fit most gp7/9 frames with minor modification required, especially old P2K frames. The N scale model fits a slightly modified Atlas GP7/9 frame (easily done with a dremel) to fit the low nose. Also included are some files for making a dummy locomotive, which includes printable Blomberg trucks, a tank, and chassis. (Note: In tandem with Kaslo Shops turn this models as been turned into a resin kit in HO scale. https://3dcentraltrains.com/collections/locomotives/products/hl-42-paducah-shops-rebuilt-gp-11-36-fan-locomotive-shell-kit  https://3dcentraltrains.com/collections/locomotives/products/hl-43-paducah-shops-rebuilt-gp-11-48-fan-locomotive-shell-kit.)

description_text:
3d model of the Bugatti Centodieci, a mid-engine hiper sports car from 2020.
This car is a tribute to the Bugatti EB110, the model that marked the brand's revival and Ettore Bugatti's 110th birthday, in the 1990s, and also celebrates the brand's current 110 years.
It is the ideal 3d model to use in your projects, in all kinds of environments, especially where you want a luxurious, sporty, refined and exclusive environment.
The modulation has been simplified in order to reduce the file weight, but it guarantees the essential forms of the real model without being too faceted.Therefore is possible to use it in larger environments, such as parking lots or urban spaces, but also in projects that require more detail.
It’s a low-poly model, on full-scale, with real photos texture (single 2048 x 2048 png), very light and fast to render.
Compatible Metaverses(according to requirements available on their websites):

  - Spark AR (meta - facebook and Instagram)

  - Snap AR (lens studio)

  - TikTok (effecthouse)

In addition to the original texture (png 2024x2024) extra textures are provided for support if needed (png 1024x1024 + jpg 1024x1024 and 2048x2048)
Hope you enjoy it.
José Bronze

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This model was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized via ZRemesher within Zbrush. It has animation ready topology wrapped on top of the scan in Wrap3. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a surgical nurse. The model is captured in the A-pose with mesh ready for rigging and animation in all most usable 3d software.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, inside Game Engines or for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - edge Loops based

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

  - ready for animation

  - PBR textures 8K/4K resolution: Normal, Displacement, Albedo maps

  - Cinema 4d project file and redshift shader included. You can find all PBR textures in tex folder inside cinema 4d project folder.

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
Every day, thousands of London's residents and visitors hail a licensed taxi, a unique vehicle that is as much a symbol of London as Big Ben and the double-decker bus. The operators of these taxis are legendary for their encyclopedic knowledge of the British capital but the fascinating history of the vehicles they drive is less apparent to the casual observer.
The first motorized London taxi, the 1897 Bersey, was electrically powered and was called the Hummingbird because of its sound. Its limited range led to the introduction of gasoline-powered taxis in 1903 and the French-built Prunel was the first example. In the ensuing decades, many domestic and foreign manufacturers including Vauxhall, Unic, Rational and Renault would offer vehicles built to conform to the Conditions of Fitness. Since 1930, London's licensed taxis have been British-built by various manufacturers including Morris, Beardmore, Winchester and Austin. The most familiar of these are the Austin FX3 and FX4.
The FX4 replaced the FX3 in 1959. Its body design was updated dramatically and, with minor modifications, would remain unchanged for decades. Unlike the FX3, all FX4s had a fourth door enclosing the luggage compartment. The FX4 continued the rear-hinged passenger doors but the FX3's hydraulic jacks could not be incorporated into the new design. Fully hydraulic brakes and improved instrumentation were among the FX4's innovations and early models can be identified by bunny ears turn indicators on the roof. The spacious passenger compartment incorporated a bench seat for two or three passengers, fold-down jump seats for two additional riders and separate heater and lighting controls. The FX4 adhered to the requirements of the Conditions of Fitness, including an amazing turning circle of only 25 feet. The new vehicle was initially powered by the FX3's 2.2 liter diesel engine and a Borg Warner automatic transmission but a gasoline engine and manual gearbox were offered as production continued.
A London taxi must undergo rigorous periodic inspections and is retired after 10 to 12 years and hundreds of thousands of miles of service. After retirement, many taxis migrate to other U.K. cities with less stringent taxi regulations where they continue in daily service.

The product contains one resolution of the model, which is rigged for animation. The model is highly detailed and textured.
This model is a 3DMax model, saved in version 8 as a MAX file, and requires 3DMax. It does not include any other formats to allow it to be opened in any other software. The model is rigged where appropriate, and mapped and textured.

description_text:
Usonia was a word used by American architect Frank Lloyd Wright to refer to his vision for the landscape of the United States, including the planning of cities and the architecture of buildings. Wright proposed the use of the adjective Usonian in place of American to describe the particular New World character of the American landscape as distinct and free of previous architectural conventions.
And Usonian is a term usually referring to a group of approximately sixty middle-income family homes designed by Frank Lloyd Wright beginning in 1936 with the Jacobs House. The "Usonian Homes" were typically small, single-story dwellings without a garage or much storage. They were often L-shaped to fit around a garden terrace on unusual and inexpensive sites. Constructed with native materials, flat roofs and large cantilevered overhangs for passive solar heating and natural cooling, natural lighting with clerestory windows, and radiant-floor heating. A strong visual connection between the interior and exterior spaces is an important characteristic of all Usonian homes.
This digital model is a house based on the Usonian style architecture, but does not represent an actual building.

description_text:
The Bradbury Building is an architectural landmark located at 304 Broadway at West 3rd Street in downtown Los Angeles, California. Built in 1893, the building was commissioned by Los Angeles gold-mining millionaire Lewis L. Bradbury and constructed by draftsman George Wyman from the original design by Sumner Hunt. It appears in many works of fiction and has been the site of many movie and television shoots and music videos.
The building was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1971, and was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1977, one of only four office buildings in Los Angeles to be so honored. It was also designated a landmark by the Los Angeles Cultural Heritage Commission and is the city's oldest landmarked building.
The building's undistinguished exterior facade of brown brick, sandstone and terra cotta detailing was designed in the commercial vernacular Italian Renaissance Revival style current at the time. It is the interior that is the most notable part of the building.
The Bradbury Building is featured prominently as a setting in films, television, and literature – particularly in the science fiction genre. Most notably, the building is the setting for both the climactic rooftop scene of Blade Runner (1982), as well as the set of the character J. F. Sebastian's apartment in which much of the film's story unfolds.

description_text:
A little history of this fine establishment...
"Cuppa Joe" was originally built in the late 1980`s as a corner bar and the place enjoyed a decent crowd of locals. Sure, there was the occasional fight and drunk person, but it gave the place a little character. Regulars would routinely come in for a game of pool or to relax after a long day.Eventually, though, the owner sold it to a new group of developers looking to gentrify the neighborhood. In 1993, the corner bar was turned into a coffee shop, of all things!
The place became even more popular as it shed its reputation as a place for people looking to get drunk. College kids and the 20 and 30-something crowd particularly enjoyed coming in and relaxing on the sofas and plush chairs. Unfortunately, it seemed like a gang of 6 friends would always hang out and monopolize the main couch and chairs. However, they suddenly stopped coming in 2004. The rumors were that they went their separate ways after one of them moved to Paris.
"Cuppa" was bought again in late 2004 and turned into a boutique book store, but this digital model will preserve its glory days as a coffee house.

description_text:
This Greyhound Racecourse Pack provides a collection of assets to construct your complete dog racing track.
A set of tile-able curved and straight track pieces snap together to construct your course (a pre-made oval track is also included), along with surrounding grass pieces and sky panorama.
4 variations of the starting box/trap are included to cater for 6 or 8 dogs, both with or without an advertisement hoarding. They all include animation for the door opening too.

Both maya and fbx model files are included.

  - Also included is a .uasset file with LOD's, collision, and a generated lightmap (place in your Unreal Engine 4 projects content folder).

  - 3DS Max Dimensions – L6.05m x W2.3m x H2.3m approximate to real world scale

Textures:

Included Maps

  -   Albedo (A)

Specular

description_text:
1940 Citroen 23R Cargo Truck
Originally modelled in 3D Max2013. The zip-file contains bodypaint textures and standard materials.Rigged to doors of cabin and wheels.
3D Model Details:

  - 3D MAX 2013 (.max) - 10.8 MB

  - Autodesk FBX 2013 (.fbx) - 4.82 MB

  - OBJ (.obj) - 8.3 MB

  - 3D Studio (.3ds) - 2.93 MB

The Citroen 23R represents a typical French Army truck in service at the beginning of World War II.The Citroen 23R was a civilian design light-truck with little modification apart from front towing hooks and a simplified front bumper. The Citroen 23R displayed has additional German Army modifications.A vehicle night-marching device, designated “Notek” by the German army, has been added to the front leftfender in typical German fashion. The Notek light allowed the driver to illuminate the roadway up to25-meters width and 40-meters length in front of the vehicle during night marches without being seen byenemy aircraft. This device became a mandatory piece of equipment early in the war to counter the ever-increasing presence of Allied air power, particularly after 1943. All German transport and armoredvehicles were required to have them. The Citroen 23Rs as well as the larger weight class French army truckscontinued in service with the German army after the invasion and occupation of 1940. Out of the total ofapproximately 6,000 Citroen 23R 1-1/2-ton trucks built, 3,700 were manufactured after 1940.
